entry.title: The Power of JDK Flight Recorder: Efficient Profiling and Troubleshooting for Java Applications
entry.summary: Take a guided tour of the JDK Flight Recorder, the powerful event recording framework for the JVM. We'll cover the basics for getting started, show how to capture and analyze rich telemetry data, and demonstrate real-world workflows for investigating performance, memory leaks, threading issues, and more.

entry.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography in Long-Term Support JDK Releases
entry.summary: Oracle is executing on a strategy to make post-quantum cryptography (PQC) broadly available across the Java ecosystem with a roadmap that brings standardized PQC algorithms and PQC-enabled TLS to current Long-Term Support (LTS) releases, helping reduce adoption friction for developers and enterprises.

entry.summary: Oracle intends to provide Java security updates more frequently than the current quarterly CPU cadence of January, April, July, and October.

entry.title: Pairing In-Process and Hosted Embeddings for Java MCP Tool Development
entry.summary: Discover why a Java MCP tool can benefit from both in-process and hosted embeddings: in-process embeddings keep development, testing, and conformance fast and reliable, while external provider-backed embeddings offer production-quality semantic scoring behind the same stable tool contract.
